findings: The RGB checks still do not implement the frozen valid-pixel fraction. Lines 119–121 average validity over individual channel elements, so one invalid channel counts as one-third of an invalid pixel rather than making the complete RGB pixel invalid. Compute `np.all(np.isfinite(rgb), axis=-1)` and `np.all(np.isfinite(rgb) & (rgb >= 0) & (rgb <= 255), axis=-1)` before taking each image fraction. The exact-1.0 gate detects any invalid channel, but the claimed measured observable and reported fraction remain incorrect.
